statement: The legend that everyone in the world knows about, the One Piece, will be explained. Luffy will reach the final island and learn what it is.
The final saga has begun. All the mysteries - the Void Century, the Ancient Weapons, the Will of D., the meaning of the One Piece - will be revealed.
Shanks will make his move soon. He's not just waiting around. There's a reason he hasn't acted yet.
The treasure is not something like 'friendship' or 'bonds'. It's a real physical reward that will make sense once revealed.
The ending has been decided from the very beginning. I know exactly how it will end. The final scene is already drawn in my head.
Roger couldn't do what needed to be done because he was too early. He was waiting for someone - that's Luffy.
Luffy's mother has been drawn already. She's alive. But I don't plan to draw her for now because it's not relevant to the adventure.
Dragon is the most wanted man because of what he knows and what he's trying to do, not just his power.
Wano has a deeper meaning to the overall story than any arc before. The connection to the Void Century will become clear.
Blackbeard is a unique existence. His ability to hold two Devil Fruits is related to his body's structure. It's not a normal human body.
Im-sama's identity will shock readers. There's a reason they sit on the Empty Throne. The world's greatest secret.
Elbaf will be important. The giants have a role to play. Usopp's dream connects to this.
The Red Line and Grand Line exist for a reason. The geography of the world is not natural - someone made it that way.
Rocks D. Xebec's story isn't over. What happened at God Valley will be revealed. It connects to the current era.
There's a reason Shanks gave Luffy the straw hat. It wasn't just sentiment. Roger wore it. It has meaning.
The Will of D. is the enemy of the gods (Celestial Dragons). The 'D' initial carries the will of those from the Void Century.
Gear 5 is Luffy's peak form. The Sun God Nika is freedom itself. This was planned since the beginning of Wano.
The Straw Hats will reach Laugh Tale. What they find there will change everything. The world will be turned upside down.
Zoro's eye being closed isn't just a design change. There might be something there.
Vegapunk knows more about the world than almost anyone. His knowledge threatens the World Government.
The final war will be the biggest war ever depicted in manga. All forces will clash.
Sanji's dream of the All Blue is not just a fairy tale. It exists. The way it will be found connects to the larger story.
Marineford was nothing compared to what's coming. The final war will make Marineford look like a warm-up.
Every Straw Hat will fulfill their dream by the end of the story. I've planned all of their conclusions.
The Void Century holds the key to everything. Once that history is revealed, the entire world of One Piece will make sense.
Shanks' power is Haki-based. He chose not to eat a Devil Fruit. His crew fights with pure skill and Haki.
The Straw Hat that Luffy wears has a history that goes back centuries. It's not just Roger's hat.
Usopp's lies have a way of becoming truth. That's intentional. Pay attention to what Usopp says - it often foreshadows real events.
Bonney's connection to Kuma is one of the most emotional stories I've ever written. Their relationship is central to the Egghead arc.
The Revolutionary Army will play a major role in the final saga. Dragon's full power and his past will be revealed.
Elbaf is an arc I've been wanting to draw for a long time. It connects to many things I've been setting up.
The Buccaneers are a race with significance to the Void Century. Kuma being a Buccaneer is very important to the plot.
I draw One Piece with the theme of freedom. Luffy doesn't want to conquer - he wants to be the freest person in the world. That's what being Pirate King means.
The ancient robot that tried to climb the Red Line 200 years ago is connected to Joy Boy and the Void Century. It will move again.
Chopper's dream of curing all diseases connects to the greater story. There's a reason why certain diseases exist in the One Piece world.
The Cross Guild with Buggy, Mihawk, and Crocodile is going to be a major force. Don't underestimate them just because Buggy is the figurehead.
